questions.question_text: Explain the meaning of the key vocabulary term 'Inseparable' in the context of 'The Unlikely Best Friends'.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Definition: Unable to be separated; extremely close companions.. Example: Gajaraj and Buntee became inseparable best friends.

questions.question_text: Provide a detailed summary (80-100 words) of 'The Unlikely Best Friends', highlighting the character actions and moral outcome.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Gajaraj was a majestic royal elephant living in luxury, while Buntee was a hungry stray dog. Despite their vast differences in size, species, and status, they connected instantly through kindness when Gajaraj shared his meal. They played together, bathed together, and slept side by side. When separated, Gajaraj risked his health by refusing food, proving that true emotional bonds matter far more than physical differences.

questions.question_text: Target Grammar Concept in Chapter 4: What is the rule regarding 'Past Continuous Tense and Prepositions'?
options: A) Past Continuous (was/were + V-ing) describes actions in progress in the past. Prepositions show location and relationship.
B) All verbs must be in future tense.

questions.correct_answer: A) Past Continuous (was/were + V-ing) describes actions in progress in the past. Prepositions show location and relationship.

questions.question_text: Guided Writing Extension: Write a diary entry from the King's perspective after reuniting Gajaraj and Buntee.
questions.marking_scheme_answer:
Format: Diary Entry. Key Value Points: Observation of elephant's grief, Discovery of the dog's importance, Joy of seeing them reunited.
Sample Output: Dear Diary, Today I witnessed a miracle of love. Our royal elephant Gajaraj was dying of heartbreak after being separated from a stray dog named Buntee. The moment Buntee was brought back, Gajaraj lifted him with his trunk and trumpeted with joy. It reminded me that true friendship is priceless.
